title.rendered: Time Wave Plus Table clock Square display with Bluetooth speaker & RGB Lights

content.rendered:
Time Wave Plus Table Clock is a modern Bluetooth speaker designed for both style and functionality. With its sleek mirror finish display and vibrant RGB lighting, this smart transforms any space into a dynamic environment while keeping you connected through sound and time.

Product Highlights

  • Square Display Clock: Clear and bright LED mirror finish for time display and visual appeal.
  • Bluetooth Speaker: Stream music wirelessly from your smartphone, tablet, or laptop.
  • RGB Light Modes: Adjustable RGB colors to set the perfect mood for any room.
  • FM Radio & TF Card Reader: Enjoy your favorite radio stations or play music directly from a TF card.
  • 1200 mAh Battery: Long-lasting rechargeable battery ensures hours of playback and clock functionality.

Why Choose Time Wave Plus?

Whether you’re upgrading your workspace, adding a modern touch to your bedside table, or searching for a gift-worthy Bluetooth speaker,  is the perfect choice. Its multifunctional design combines an elegant digital clock display, immersive audio experience, and decorative LED RGB lights – all in one compact device.

Perfect for home décor, office desk setups, and corporate gifting, the Plus Bluetooth speaker delivers convenience and class in one stylish package.
